sample_unit: patients (79,790 TPN orders, Stanford training cohort)

links.outcome: Physician blinded ratings of AI TPN recommendations versus current best-practice prescriptions
links.effect: Physicians rated TPN2.0 higher than current best practice in a blinded study (n = 192); Pearson's R = 0.94 versus experts.
links.quote: A blinded study (n = 192) revealed that physicians rated TPN2.0 higher than current best practice.

unlisted_practices: Physician-in-the-loop transformer-based recommendations adhering to clinical guidelines
Standardizing TPN formulas into 15 precision formulas using routine EHR data

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and evaluating an AI-guided precision parenteral nutrition recommendation system (TPN2.0) using retrospective EHR data, an external validation cohort, and a blinded physician reader evaluation study.
